sanskrit: tvāṁ hy a̍gne̱ sada̱m it sa̍ma̱nyavo̍ de̱vāso̍ de̱vam a̍ra̱tiṁ nye̍ri̱ra iti̱ kratvā̍ nyeri̱re | ama̍rtyaṁ yajata̱ martye̱ṣv ā de̱vam āde̍vaṁ janata̱ prace̍tasa̱ṁ viśva̱m āde̍vaṁ janata̱ prace̍tasam ||
english: Thee, O Agni, the gods of one accord have ever sent as their divine messenger — by their will they sent thee forth. The immortal one established among mortals, the divine and all-knowing Ādeva — they generated thee, the all-wise Pracetas, the divine Pracetas.

sanskrit: sa bhrāta̍ra̱ṁ varu̍ṇam agna̱ ā va̍vṛtsva de̱vām̐ acchā̍ suma̱tī ya̱jñava̍nasa̱ṁ jyeṣṭha̍ṁ ya̱jñava̍nasam | ṛ̱tāvā̍nam ādi̱tyaṁ ca̍rṣaṇī̱dhṛta̱ṁ rājā̍naṁ carṣaṇī̱dhṛta̍m ||
english: O Agni, bring hither thy brother Varuṇa together with the gods, by thy goodwill — him who is fond of sacrifice, the eldest, who delights in sacrifice. Bring the truth-bearing Āditya, upholder of peoples, the king who upholds the tribes.

sanskrit: sakhe̱ sakhā̍yam a̱bhy ā va̍vṛtsvā̱śuṁ na ca̱kraṁ rathye̍va̱ raṁhyā̱smabhya̍ṁ dasma̱ raṁhyā̍ | agne̍ mṛḻī̱kaṁ varu̍ṇe̱ sacā̍ vido ma̱rutsu̍ vi̱śvabhā̍nuṣu | to̱kāya̍ tu̱je śu̍śucāna̱ śaṁ kṛ̍dhy a̱smabhya̍ṁ dasma̱ śaṁ kṛ̍dhi ||
english: As a friend, turn thy friend hither, as a wheel on the chariot-track hastens swiftly — hasten toward us, O wondrous one. O Agni, find grace for us together with Varuṇa, among the Maruts of universal splendor. Grant bliss to our offspring and strength, O blazing one — grant us welfare, O wondrous one, grant us welfare.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ agne̱ varu̍ṇasya vi̱dvān de̱vasya̱ heḻo 'va̍ yāsisīṣṭhāḥ | yaji̍ṣṭho̱ vahni̍tama̱ḥ śośu̍cāno̱ viśvā̱ dveṣā̍ṁsi̱ pra mu̍mugdhy a̱smat ||
english: Thou, O Agni, knowing the wrath of god Varuṇa, shouldst turn it away from us. Thou who art most worthy of worship, best of conveyors, ever blazing — drive away all hatreds from us.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ no̍ agne 'va̱mo bha̍vo̱tī nedi̍ṣṭho a̱syā u̱ṣaso̱ vyu̍ṣṭau | ava̍ yakṣva no̱ varu̍ṇa̱ṁ rarā̍ṇo vī̱hi mṛ̍ḻī̱kaṁ su̱havo̍ na edhi ||
english: Be thou, O Agni, our lowest and nearest aid at the break of this dawn. Worship Varuṇa on our behalf and bestow grace — come to us with clemency and be easy to invoke.

sanskrit: a̱sya śreṣṭhā̍ su̱bhaga̍sya sa̱ṁdṛg de̱vasya̍ ci̱trata̍mā̱ martye̍ṣu | śuci̍ ghṛ̱taṁ na ta̱ptam aghnyā̍yāḥ spā̱rhā de̱vasya̍ ma̱ṁhane̍va dhe̱noḥ ||
english: The most excellent and most wonderful vision of this blessed god among mortals — pure like clarified butter heated up, like the munificence of the inviolable cow, desirable and divine.

sanskrit: trir a̍sya̱ tā pa̍ra̱mā sa̍nti sa̱tyā spā̱rhā de̱vasya̱ jani̍māny a̱gneḥ | a̱na̱nte a̱ntaḥ pari̍vīta̱ āgā̱c chuci̍ḥ śu̱kro a̱ryo roru̍cānaḥ ||
english: Threefold are those supreme, true, and desirable births of divine Agni. He comes enclosed within the limitless, blazing, bright, noble, and radiantly gleaming.

sanskrit: sa dū̱to viśved a̱bhi va̍ṣṭi̱ sadmā̱ hotā̱ hira̍ṇyaratho̱ raṁsu̍jihvaḥ | ro̱hida̍śvo vapu̱ṣyo̍ vi̱bhāvā̱ sadā̍ ra̱ṇvaḥ pi̍tu̱matī̍va sa̱ṁsat ||
english: He is the messenger who pervades every dwelling, the Hotṛ with a golden chariot and a tongue of copper, with red horses, beautiful in form, of great light — ever joyous, the assembly of which is like one rich in food.

sanskrit: sa ce̍taya̱n manu̍ṣo ya̱jñaba̍ndhu̱ḥ pra tam ma̱hyā ra̍śa̱nayā̍ nayanti | sa kṣe̍ty asya̱ duryā̍su̱ sādha̍n de̱vo marta̍sya sadhani̱tvam ā̍pa ||
english: Awakening men — this bond of sacrifice — they lead him forth by great thongs. Achieving his goal among the houses of his worshiper, the divine one attained partnership with the mortal.

sanskrit: sa tū no̍ a̱gnir na̍yatu prajā̱nann acchā̱ ratna̍ṁ de̱vabha̍kta̱ṁ yad a̍sya | dhi̱yā yad viśve̍ a̱mṛtā̱ akṛ̍ṇva̱n dyauṣ pi̱tā ja̍ni̱tā sa̱tyam u̍kṣan ||
english: May Agni, knowing the way, lead us toward that treasure appointed by the gods. That which all the immortals fashioned by thought, that which Father Dyaus, the begetter, made true and watered.

sanskrit: sa jā̍yata pratha̱maḥ pa̱styā̍su ma̱ho bu̱dhne raja̍so a̱sya yonau̍ | a̱pād a̍śī̱rṣā gu̱hamā̍no̱ antā̱yoyu̍vāno vṛṣa̱bhasya̍ nī̱ḻe ||
english: He was born first in the households, at the base of great heaven, in the womb of this aerial space — footless and headless, hiding at the extremities, stretching within the nest of the Bull.

sanskrit: pra śardha̍ ārta pratha̱maṁ vi̍pa̱nyām̐ ṛ̱tasya̱ yonā̍ vṛṣa̱bhasya̍ nī̱ḻe | spā̱rho yuvā̍ vapu̱ṣyo̍ vi̱bhāvā̍ sa̱pta pri̱yāso̍ 'janayanta̱ vṛṣṇe̍ ||
english: First among those worthy of praise he arose from the womb of Ṛta, in the nest of the Bull — desirable, youthful, beautiful, and of great radiance. Seven beloved ones generated him for the Bull.

sanskrit: a̱smāka̱m atra̍ pi̱taro̍ manu̱ṣyā̍ a̱bhi pra se̍dur ṛ̱tam ā̍śuṣā̱ṇāḥ | aśma̍vrajāḥ su̱dughā̍ va̱vre a̱ntar ud u̱srā ā̍jann u̱ṣaso̍ huvā̱nāḥ ||
english: Here our fathers, the human ones, pressed forward seeking after Ṛta. Calling upon the Dawns, they drove up the radiant cows locked within the stone-walled pen, the well-milking ones within the cavern.

sanskrit: te ma̍rmṛjata dadṛ̱vāṁso̱ adri̱ṁ tad e̍ṣām a̱nye a̱bhito̱ vi vo̍can | pa̱śvaya̍ntrāso a̱bhi kā̱ram a̍rcan vi̱danta̱ jyoti̍ś cakṛ̱panta̍ dhī̱bhiḥ ||
english: Having shattered the rock they polished it; others among them declared this to all around. Without restraint they sang in praise of the work; finding the light they shaped it with their thoughts.

sanskrit: te ga̍vya̱tā mana̍sā dṛ̱dhram u̱bdhaṁ gā ye̍mā̱nam pari̱ ṣanta̱m adri̍m | dṛ̱ḻhaṁ naro̱ vaca̍sā̱ daivye̍na vra̱jaṁ goma̍ntam u̱śijo̱ vi va̍vruḥ ||
english: With cow-seeking mind they surrounded the mountain that was hard, compact, and enclosing the cows. With divine speech the men, the Uśijas, opened up the firm cattle-pen full of kine.

sanskrit: te ma̍nvata pratha̱maṁ nāma̍ dhe̱nos triḥ sa̱pta mā̱tuḥ pa̍ra̱māṇi̍ vindan | taj jā̍na̱tīr a̱bhy a̍nūṣata̱ vrā ā̱vir bhu̍vad aru̱ṇīr ya̱śasā̱ goḥ ||
english: They first thought of the name of the cow; they found the three-times-seven highest names of the mother. Knowing these, the companies sang after them; the glorious red Dawn-cow became manifest.

sanskrit: neśa̱t tamo̱ dudhi̍ta̱ṁ roca̍ta̱ dyaur ud de̱vyā u̱ṣaso̍ bhā̱nur a̍rta | ā sūryo̍ bṛha̱tas ti̍ṣṭha̱d ajrā̍m̐ ṛ̱ju marte̍ṣu vṛji̱nā ca̱ paśya̍n ||
english: Darkness was dispelled, heaven shone; the light of the divine Dawns arose. The Sun stood upon the broad meadows, seeing the straight and the crooked among mortals.

sanskrit: ād it pa̱ścā bu̍budhā̱nā vy a̍khya̱nn ād id ratna̍ṁ dhārayanta̱ dyubha̍ktam | viśve̱ viśvā̍su̱ duryā̍su de̱vā mitra̍ dhi̱ye va̍ruṇa sa̱tyam a̍stu ||
english: Thereupon, awakening, they beheld each other; thereupon they held the heaven-given treasure. May all the gods in all the dwellings — O Mitra, O Varuṇa — let truth be in our thought.

sanskrit: acchā̍ voceya śuśucā̱nam a̱gniṁ hotā̍raṁ vi̱śvabha̍rasa̱ṁ yaji̍ṣṭham | śucy ūdho̍ atṛṇa̱n na gavā̱m andho̱ na pū̱tam pari̍ṣiktam a̱ṁśoḥ ||
english: I would speak praise toward blazing Agni, the Hotṛ, the all-sustaining, the most worthy of worship — whose bright udder the cows did not consume, whose pressed Soma was not drunk, like that poured around the filter.

sanskrit: viśve̍ṣā̱m adi̍tir ya̱jñiyā̍nā̱ṁ viśve̍ṣā̱m ati̍thi̱r mānu̍ṣāṇām | a̱gnir de̱vānā̱m ava̍ āvṛṇā̱naḥ su̍mṛḻī̱ko bha̍vatu jā̱tave̍dāḥ ||
english: Aditi of all the worshipable beings, guest of all human beings — may Agni, winning the favor of the gods, become gracious to us, the all-knowing Jātavedas.

sanskrit: yo martye̍ṣv a̱mṛta̍ ṛ̱tāvā̍ de̱vo de̱veṣv a̍ra̱tir ni̱dhāyi̍ | hotā̱ yaji̍ṣṭho ma̱hnā śu̱cadhyai̍ ha̱vyair a̱gnir manu̍ṣa īra̱yadhyai̍ ||
english: He who, the immortal truth-bearer, was established as the divine messenger among the gods — Agni, the Hotṛ, most worthy of worship, set among mortals to blaze magnificently, to be stirred with oblations.

sanskrit: i̱ha tvaṁ sū̍no sahaso no a̱dya jā̱to jā̱tām̐ u̱bhayā̍m̐ a̱ntar a̍gne | dū̱ta ī̍yase yuyujā̱na ṛ̍ṣva ṛjumu̱ṣkān vṛṣa̍ṇaḥ śu̱krām̐ś ca̍ ||
english: Here today, O son of power, born between the two kindred, O Agni — thou goest as a lofty messenger having yoked the straight-membered, bull-like, bright horses.

sanskrit: atyā̍ vṛdha̱snū rohi̍tā ghṛ̱tasnū̍ ṛ̱tasya̍ manye̱ mana̍sā̱ javi̍ṣṭhā | a̱ntar ī̍yase aru̱ṣā yu̍jā̱no yu̱ṣmām̐ś ca̍ de̱vān viśa̱ ā ca̱ martā̍n ||
english: Those exceeding, exhilarating, red, and ghee-dripping steeds I deem the swiftest by mind — belonging to Ṛta. Yoked with the red ones thou goest between you gods and the clans of mortals.

sanskrit: a̱rya̱maṇa̱ṁ varu̍ṇam mi̱tram e̍ṣā̱m indrā̱viṣṇū̍ ma̱ruto̍ a̱śvino̱ta | svaśvo̍ agne su̱ratha̍ḥ su̱rādhā̱ ed u̍ vaha suha̱viṣe̱ janā̍ya ||
english: Bring Aryaman, Varuṇa, Mitra among these, Indra, Viṣṇu, the Maruts, and the Aśvins. O Agni, with good horses, fine chariot, and excellent gifts, do convey them to the people of good oblations.

sanskrit: gomā̍m̐ a̱gne 'vi̍mām̐ a̱śvī ya̱jño nṛ̱vatsa̍khā̱ sada̱m id a̍pramṛ̱ṣyaḥ | iḻā̍vām̐ e̱ṣo a̍sura pra̱jāvā̍n dī̱rgho ra̱yiḥ pṛ̍thubu̱dhnaḥ sa̱bhāvā̍n ||
english: O Agni, let our sacrifice be possessed of kine, possessed of sheep, possessed of horses, friend to heroes, ever imperishable. O mighty one, may this wealth be rich in refreshment, in offspring, long-lasting, broad-based, and fit for the assembly.

sanskrit: yas ta̍ i̱dhmaṁ ja̱bhara̍t siṣvidā̱no mū̱rdhāna̍ṁ vā ta̱tapa̍te tvā̱yā | bhuva̱s tasya̱ svata̍vām̐ḥ pā̱yur a̍gne̱ viśva̍smāt sīm aghāya̱ta u̍ruṣya ||
english: He who brings thee fuel perspiring, or scorches his head on account of thee — become thou his mighty guardian, O Agni, and protect him from every evil-doer.

sanskrit: yas te̱ bharā̱d anni̍yate ci̱d anna̍ṁ ni̱śiṣa̍n ma̱ndram ati̍thim u̱dīra̍t | ā de̍va̱yur i̱nadha̍te duro̱ṇe tasmi̍n ra̱yir dhru̱vo a̍stu̱ dāsvā̍n ||
english: He who brings thee food — even food desired — sharpening, arousing the joyous guest; the god-seeking one who kindles thee in his home — in him may wealth be steadfast and may he be a giver.

sanskrit: yas tvā̍ do̱ṣā ya u̱ṣasi̍ pra̱śaṁsā̍t pri̱yaṁ vā̍ tvā kṛ̱ṇava̍te ha̱viṣmā̍n | aśvo̱ na sve dama̱ ā he̱myāvā̱n tam aṁha̍saḥ pīparo dā̱śvāṁsa̍m ||
english: He who praises thee at evening or at dawn, or who, possessing oblations, makes thee a beloved offering — like a horse with golden trappings in its own stable, carry that worshiper beyond distress.

sanskrit: yas tubhya̍m agne a̱mṛtā̍ya̱ dāśa̱d duva̱s tve kṛ̱ṇava̍te ya̱tasru̍k | na sa rā̱yā śa̍śamā̱no vi yo̍ṣa̱n naina̱m aṁha̱ḥ pari̍ varad aghā̱yoḥ ||
english: He who makes offering to thee, O immortal Agni, and performs service to thee with ladle extended — may he not be separated from wealth when he has striven; let no distress from the evil one encircle him.

sanskrit: yasya̱ tvam a̍gne adhva̱raṁ jujo̍ṣo de̱vo marta̍sya̱ sudhi̍ta̱ṁ rarā̍ṇaḥ | prī̱ted a̍sa̱d dhotrā̱ sā ya̍vi̱ṣṭhāsā̍ma̱ yasya̍ vidha̱to vṛ̱dhāsa̍ḥ ||
english: He whose sacrifice thou, O Agni, hast enjoyed — the god bestowing well-placed boons on the mortal — may his Hotṛ-service be pleasing, O most youthful; may we be those whose worshiper prospers.

sanskrit: citti̱m aci̍ttiṁ cinava̱d vi vi̱dvān pṛ̱ṣṭheva̍ vī̱tā vṛ̍ji̱nā ca̱ martā̍n | rā̱ye ca̍ naḥ svapa̱tyāya̍ deva̱ diti̍ṁ ca̱ rāsvādi̍tim uruṣya ||
english: O all-knowing one, discern wisdom and unwisdom, separating mortals as if separating the clean from the crooked. For our prosperity and good offspring, O god, grant us bounty and Aditi, and protect us.

sanskrit: ka̱viṁ śa̍śāsuḥ ka̱vayo 'da̍bdhā nidhā̱raya̍nto̱ duryā̍sv ā̱yoḥ | ata̱s tvaṁ dṛśyā̍m̐ agna e̱tān pa̱ḍbhiḥ pa̍śye̱r adbhu̍tām̐ a̱rya evai̍ḥ ||
english: The undeceivable seers have instructed the seer, holding him firmly in the houses of life. Therefore, O Agni, mayst thou — visible — see those wondrous things with thy feet and thine own noble steps.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne vā̱ghate̍ su̱praṇī̍tiḥ su̱taso̍māya vidha̱te ya̍viṣṭha | ratna̍m bhara śaśamā̱nāya̍ ghṛṣve pṛ̱thu śca̱ndram ava̍se carṣaṇi̱prāḥ ||
english: Thou, O Agni, art a good guide to the lauding poet who presses Soma and worships — O most youthful, thou who art dear to peoples. Bring a wide and shining treasure to the striving one for his protection.

sanskrit: adhā̍ ha̱ yad va̱yam a̍gne tvā̱yā pa̱ḍbhir haste̍bhiś cakṛ̱mā ta̱nūbhi̍ḥ | ratha̱ṁ na kranto̱ apa̍sā bhu̱rijo̍r ṛ̱taṁ ye̍muḥ su̱dhya̍ āśuṣā̱ṇāḥ ||
english: For when we have done this by thy aid, O Agni, with feet, hands, and bodies — like those who equip a chariot through the effort of both arms — the clear-minded ones, eagerly seeking, have grasped the truth.

sanskrit: adhā̍ mā̱tur u̱ṣasa̍ḥ sa̱pta viprā̱ jāye̍mahi pratha̱mā ve̱dhaso̱ nṝn | di̱vas pu̱trā aṅgi̍raso bhave̱mādri̍ṁ rujema dha̱nina̍ṁ śu̱canta̍ḥ ||
english: Then may we seven inspired ones be born first from the mother Dawn, as creators of men. May we become sons of Heaven, Aṅgirases, and burst open the wealth-laden mountain while we shine.

sanskrit: adhā̱ yathā̍ naḥ pi̱tara̱ḥ parā̍saḥ pra̱tnāso̍ agna ṛ̱tam ā̍śuṣā̱ṇāḥ | śucīd a̍ya̱n dīdhi̍tim uktha̱śāsa̱ḥ kṣāmā̍ bhi̱ndanto̍ aru̱ṇīr apa̍ vran ||
english: Just as our fathers of old, O Agni, eagerly seeking Ṛta, went in purity to the inspiring thought — singing praises, shattering the earth, they drove forth the reddish cows.

sanskrit: su̱karmā̍ṇaḥ su̱ruco̍ deva̱yanto 'yo̱ na de̱vā jani̍mā̱ dhama̍ntaḥ | śu̱canto̍ a̱gniṁ va̍vṛ̱dhanta̱ indra̍m ū̱rvaṁ gavya̍m pari̱ṣada̍nto agman ||
english: Good workers of fine brilliance, desiring the gods, like iron, the gods blowing on their birth — shining, they magnified Agni and Indra, and came surrounding the vast cattle-pen.

sanskrit: ā yū̱theva̍ kṣu̱mati̍ pa̱śvo a̍khyad de̱vānā̱ṁ yaj jani̱mānty u̍gra | martā̍nāṁ cid u̱rvaśī̍r akṛpran vṛ̱dhe ci̍d a̱rya upa̍rasyā̱yoḥ ||
english: As it looked upon the rich cattle-herd, when the mighty births of the gods appeared — even the Urvaśīs of mortals lamented, O noble one, for the upward course of life to grow.

sanskrit: aka̍rma te̱ svapa̍so abhūma ṛ̱tam a̍vasrann u̱ṣaso̍ vibhā̱tīḥ | anū̍nam a̱gnim pu̍ru̱dhā su̍śca̱ndraṁ de̱vasya̱ marmṛ̍jata̱ś cāru̱ cakṣu̍ḥ ||
english: We have become skilled workers through thy deeds; the dawns, shining forth, flowed with truth. Tending Agni, complete and widely brilliant, they polished the beautiful eye of the god.

sanskrit: e̱tā te̍ agna u̱cathā̍ni ve̱dho 'vo̍cāma ka̱vaye̱ tā ju̍ṣasva | uc cho̍casva kṛṇu̱hi vasya̍so no ma̱ho rā̱yaḥ pu̍ruvāra̱ pra ya̍ndhi ||
english: These hymns, O Agni, O wise ordainer, we have spoken — enjoy them, O seer. Blaze up high, make us better; grant us great wealth, O thou of many gifts.

sanskrit: ā vo̱ rājā̍nam adhva̱rasya̍ ru̱draṁ hotā̍raṁ satya̱yaja̱ṁ roda̍syoḥ | a̱gnim pu̱rā ta̍nayi̱tnor a̱cittā̱d dhira̍ṇyarūpa̱m ava̍se kṛṇudhvam ||
english: Seek ye the king of the sacrifice, Rudra, the Hotṛ, the true worshiper of the two worlds — Agni of golden form, before the crash of the unconscious thunder, for our protection.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ yoni̍ś cakṛ̱mā yaṁ va̱yaṁ te̍ jā̱yeva̱ patya̍ uśa̱tī su̱vāsā̍ḥ | a̱rvā̱cī̱naḥ pari̍vīto̱ ni ṣī̍de̱mā u̍ te svapāka pratī̱cīḥ ||
english: This womb we have made for thee — as a wife, desirous and well-dressed, for her husband. Sit down here facing toward us, surrounded — these offerings face thee, O thou of beautiful radiance.

sanskrit: ā̱śṛ̱ṇva̱te adṛ̍pitāya̱ manma̍ nṛ̱cakṣa̍se sumṛḻī̱kāya̍ vedhaḥ | de̱vāya̍ śa̱stim a̱mṛtā̍ya śaṁsa̱ grāve̍va̱ sotā̍ madhu̱ṣud yam ī̱ḻe ||
english: Pronounce the hymn for him who listens, the inviolate, the ordainer who sees with a hero's eyes, who is gracious — praise the immortal god, whom I, like a Soma-presser with pressing-stone, seek as the honey-squeezer.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ci̍n na̱ḥ śamyā̍ agne a̱syā ṛ̱tasya̍ bodhy ṛtacit svā̱dhīḥ | ka̱dā ta̍ u̱kthā sa̍dha̱mādyā̍ni ka̱dā bha̍vanti sa̱khyā gṛ̱he te̍ ||
english: Do thou, O Agni, O most kindly one, O wise truth-perceiver, be aware of this Ṛta. When shall thy hymns be those to be rejoiced in together? When shall thy friendships be in thy house?

sanskrit: ka̱thā ha̱ tad varu̍ṇāya̱ tvam a̍gne ka̱thā di̱ve ga̍rhase̱ kan na̱ āga̍ḥ | ka̱thā mi̱trāya̍ mī̱ḻhuṣe̍ pṛthi̱vyai brava̱ḥ kad a̍rya̱mṇe kad bhagā̍ya ||
english: O Agni, how wilt thou speak to Varuṇa? How dost thou reproach Heaven for our transgression? How wilt thou speak to the bounteous Mitra and to Earth? What wilt thou say to Aryaman, what to Bhaga?

sanskrit: kad dhiṣṇyā̍su vṛdhasā̱no a̍gne̱ kad vātā̍ya̱ prata̍vase śubha̱ṁye | pari̍jmane̱ nāsa̍tyāya̱ kṣe brava̱ḥ kad a̍gne ru̱drāya̍ nṛ̱ghne ||
english: O Agni, what wilt thou say, thriving in thy seats, to Vāta the wide-spread and beautiful? What wilt thou say to the all-wandering Nāsatya? What to Rudra who smites heroes, O Agni?

sanskrit: ka̱thā ma̱he pu̍ṣṭimbha̱rāya̍ pū̱ṣṇe kad ru̱drāya̱ suma̍khāya havi̱rde | kad viṣṇa̍va urugā̱yāya̱ reto̱ brava̱ḥ kad a̍gne̱ śara̍ve bṛha̱tyai ||
english: What wilt thou say to great Pūṣan, the nurturer? What to Rudra of beautiful face, who gives oblations? What wilt thou announce to wide-striding Viṣṇu? What, O Agni, to great Śarva?

sanskrit: ka̱thā śardhā̍ya ma̱rutā̍m ṛ̱tāya̍ ka̱thā sū̱re bṛ̍ha̱te pṛ̱cchyamā̍naḥ | prati̍ bra̱vo 'di̍taye tu̱rāya̱ sādhā̍ di̱vo jā̍tavedaś ciki̱tvān ||
english: Being questioned, what wilt thou say to the truth-bearing troop of Maruts, what to the great, mighty Sun? Speak back to swift Aditi duly, O Jātavedas, all-knowing one of heaven.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tena̍ ṛ̱taṁ niya̍tam īḻa̱ ā gor ā̱mā sacā̱ madhu̍mat pa̱kvam a̍gne | kṛ̱ṣṇā sa̱tī ruśa̍tā dhā̱sinai̱ṣā jāma̍ryeṇa̱ paya̍sā pīpāya ||
english: By Ṛta seek the fixed truth, the raw and the ripe together with the honey — of the cow, O Agni. Though black, she swelled with kindred milk by the white nourisher, this one.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tena̱ hi ṣmā̍ vṛṣa̱bhaś ci̍d a̱ktaḥ pumā̍m̐ a̱gniḥ paya̍sā pṛ̱ṣṭhye̍na | aspa̍ndamāno acarad vayo̱dhā vṛṣā̍ śu̱kraṁ du̍duhe̱ pṛśni̱r ūdha̍ḥ ||
english: For even the bull, anointed with Ṛta, masculine Agni, by the milk on his back, moved without trembling as life-sustainer; the bull milked the bright udder of Pṛśni.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tenādri̱ṁ vy a̍san bhi̱danta̱ḥ sam aṅgi̍raso navanta̱ gobhi̍ḥ | śu̱naṁ nara̱ḥ pari̍ ṣadann u̱ṣāsa̍m ā̱viḥ sva̍r abhavaj jā̱te a̱gnau ||
english: Shattering the mountain by Ṛta, the Aṅgirases rejoiced together with the kine. The men of good fortune sat around the Dawn; the sun-world became manifest when Agni was kindled.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tena̍ de̱vīr a̱mṛtā̱ amṛ̍ktā̱ arṇo̍bhi̱r āpo̱ madhu̍madbhir agne | vā̱jī na sarge̍ṣu prastubhā̱naḥ pra sada̱m it sravi̍tave dadhanyuḥ ||
english: By Ṛta the divine, immortal, inviolate waters, with their honey-sweet floods, O Agni — like a prize horse in races, ever pressing forward to flow, they were ever ready.

sanskrit: mā kasya̍ ya̱kṣaṁ sada̱m id dhu̱ro gā̱ mā ve̱śasya̍ pramina̱to māpeḥ | mā bhrātu̍r agne̱ anṛ̍jor ṛ̱ṇaṁ ve̱r mā sakhyu̱r dakṣa̍ṁ ri̱por bhu̍jema ||
english: Let us not always bear the deceitful man's burden; let us not injure the lodger or approach him. Let us not, O Agni, reap the debt of the dishonest brother; let us not share the cunning of a treacherous friend.

sanskrit: rakṣā̍ ṇo agne̱ tava̱ rakṣa̍ṇebhī rārakṣā̱ṇaḥ su̍makha prīṇā̱naḥ | prati̍ ṣphura̱ vi ru̍ja vī̱ḍv aṁho̍ ja̱hi rakṣo̱ mahi̍ cid vāvṛdhā̱nam ||
english: Protect us, O Agni, with thy protections, guarding us ceaselessly, O beautiful one, propitious. Kick back, smash the firm evil; slay the demon even though it has grown great.

sanskrit: e̱bhir bha̍va su̱manā̍ agne a̱rkair i̱mān spṛ̍śa̱ manma̍bhiḥ śūra̱ vājā̍n | u̱ta brahmā̍ṇy aṅgiro juṣasva̱ saṁ te̍ śa̱stir de̱vavā̍tā jareta ||
english: Be gracious with these songs, O Agni — touch these prizes with hymns, O hero. And enjoy the prayers, O Aṅgiras; may thy praise, beloved of the gods, be kindled.

sanskrit: e̱tā viśvā̍ vi̱duṣe̱ tubhya̍ṁ vedho nī̱thāny a̍gne ni̱ṇyā vacā̍ṁsi | ni̱vaca̍nā ka̱vaye̱ kāvyā̱ny aśa̍ṁsiṣam ma̱tibhi̱r vipra̍ u̱kthaiḥ ||
english: All these mysteries, O Agni, O ordainer, I have proclaimed to thee, the all-knowing — traditional sayings, secret words. I have sung poetic works fit for the seer, with thoughts, O inspired one, with hymns.

sanskrit: kṛ̱ṇu̱ṣva pāja̱ḥ prasi̍ti̱ṁ na pṛ̱thvīṁ yā̱hi rāje̱vāma̍vā̱m̐ ibhe̍na | tṛ̱ṣvīm anu̱ prasi̍tiṁ drūṇā̱no 'stā̍si̱ vidhya̍ ra̱kṣasa̱s tapi̍ṣṭhaiḥ ||
english: Make thy force broad as an extended track; go like a king powerful with his elephant. Raging along the fierce trail, be the archer — pierce the demons with thy hottest darts.

sanskrit: tava̍ bhra̱māsa̍ āśu̱yā pa̍ta̱nty anu̍ spṛśa dhṛṣa̱tā śośu̍cānaḥ | tapū̍ṁṣy agne ju̱hvā̍ pata̱ṁgān asa̍ṁdito̱ vi sṛ̍ja̱ viṣva̍g u̱lkāḥ ||
english: Thy circlings fly swiftly; blazing boldly, thou dost touch with thy tongue the burning things; O Agni, hurl the heat-sparks, and unconstrained, let loose firebrands in all directions.

sanskrit: prati̱ spaśo̱ vi sṛ̍ja̱ tūrṇi̍tamo̱ bhavā̍ pā̱yur vi̱śo a̱syā ada̍bdhaḥ | yo no̍ dū̱re a̱ghaśa̍ṁso̱ yo anty agne̱ māki̍ṣ ṭe̱ vyathi̱r ā da̍dharṣīt ||
english: Send forth thy scouts in all directions, swiftest one; be the unsupplanted guardian of this tribe. Whether the evil-speaker be far or near, O Agni, let no confusion dare to overpower thee.

sanskrit: ud a̍gne tiṣṭha̱ praty ā ta̍nuṣva̱ ny a1̱̍mitrā̍m̐ oṣatāt tigmahete | yo no̱ arā̍tiṁ samidhāna ca̱kre nī̱cā taṁ dha̍kṣy ata̱saṁ na śuṣka̍m ||
english: Rise up, O Agni, spread thyself out and against them, O sharp-weaponed one — burn our enemies down. Whoever has created enmity against us, O enkindled one, burn him down below like dry tinder.

sanskrit: ū̱rdhvo bha̍va̱ prati̍ vi̱dhyādhy a̱smad ā̱viṣ kṛ̍ṇuṣva̱ daivyā̍ny agne | ava̍ sthi̱rā ta̍nuhi yātu̱jūnā̍ṁ jā̱mim ajā̍mi̱m pra mṛ̍ṇīhi̱ śatrū̍n ||
english: Stand upright, shoot past us, make the divine powers manifest, O Agni. Bend low the firm ones of the sorcerers; crush the related and unrelated enemies.

sanskrit: sa te̍ jānāti suma̱tiṁ ya̍viṣṭha̱ ya īva̍te̱ brahma̍ṇe gā̱tum aira̍t | viśvā̍ny asmai su̱dinā̍ni rā̱yo dyu̱mnāny a̱ryo vi duro̍ a̱bhi dyau̍t ||
english: He knows thy favor, O most youthful, who has opened a path for the advancing brahman. To him may all the bright days of wealth and glories of the noble one shine through the doors.

sanskrit: sed a̍gne astu su̱bhaga̍ḥ su̱dānu̱r yas tvā̱ nitye̍na ha̱viṣā̱ ya u̱kthaiḥ | piprī̍ṣati̱ sva āyu̍ṣi duro̱ṇe viśved a̍smai su̱dinā̱ sāsa̍d i̱ṣṭiḥ ||
english: May he, O Agni, be fortunate and bountiful who seeks to satisfy thee with regular oblation and with hymns in his own house and lifetime; may all bright days and his sacrifice be fulfilled for him.

sanskrit: arcā̍mi te suma̱tiṁ ghoṣy a̱rvāk saṁ te̍ vā̱vātā̍ jaratām i̱yaṁ gīḥ | svaśvā̍s tvā su̱rathā̍ marjayemā̱sme kṣa̱trāṇi̍ dhāraye̱r anu̱ dyūn ||
english: I sing to call down thy favor; may this song be in accord with what thou desirest. With good horses and fine chariots may we honor thee; may thou sustain sovereignty in us through the days.

sanskrit: i̱ha tvā̱ bhūry ā ca̍re̱d upa̱ tman doṣā̍vastar dīdi̱vāṁsa̱m anu̱ dyūn | krīḻa̍ntas tvā su̱mana̍saḥ sapemā̱bhi dyu̱mnā ta̍sthi̱vāṁso̱ janā̍nām ||
english: Here may much come near thee of thyself, shining in the evenings day by day. Playing, may we, well-disposed, worship thee, having attained the glories of the peoples.

sanskrit: yas tvā̱ svaśva̍ḥ suhira̱ṇyo a̍gna upa̱yāti̱ vasu̍matā̱ rathe̍na | tasya̍ trā̱tā bha̍vasi̱ tasya̱ sakhā̱ yas ta̍ āti̱thyam ā̍nu̱ṣag jujo̍ṣat ||
english: He who comes to thee, O Agni, with good horses and fine gold, with a wealth-laden chariot — thou art his protector, thou art his friend — he who has continuously enjoyed thy hospitality.

sanskrit: ma̱ho ru̍jāmi ba̱ndhutā̱ vaco̍bhi̱s tan mā̍ pi̱tur gota̍mā̱d anv i̍yāya | tvaṁ no̍ a̱sya vaca̍saś cikiddhi̱ hota̍r yaviṣṭha sukrato̱ damū̍nāḥ ||
english: I break the great kinship with words; that came to me from father Gotama. Do thou mark this our speech, O Hotṛ, most youthful, of pure will, O dweller in the house.

sanskrit: asva̍pnajas ta̱raṇa̍yaḥ su̱śevā̱ ata̍ndrāso 'vṛ̱kā aśra̍miṣṭhāḥ | te pā̱yava̍ḥ sa̱dhrya̍ñco ni̱ṣadyāgne̱ tava̍ naḥ pāntv amūra ||
english: Unsleeping, swift, auspicious, unwearied, undevoured, untired — let those guardians, O Agni, sitting together toward the same goal, protect us, O wise one.

sanskrit: ye pā̱yavo̍ māmate̱yaṁ te̍ agne̱ paśya̍nto a̱ndhaṁ du̍ri̱tād ara̍kṣan | ra̱rakṣa̱ tān su̱kṛto̍ vi̱śvave̍dā̱ dipsa̍nta̱ id ri̱pavo̱ nāha̍ debhuḥ ||
english: Those guardians of Māmateya — thine, O Agni — watching, they protected from evil, keeping the blind at bay. The all-knowing one preserved them, the doers of good; the enemies, though wishing to harm, did not deceive them.

sanskrit: tvayā̍ va̱yaṁ sa̍dha̱nya1̱̍s tvotā̱s tava̱ praṇī̍ty aśyāma̱ vājā̍n | u̱bhā śaṁsā̍ sūdaya satyatāte 'nuṣṭhu̱yā kṛ̍ṇuhy ahrayāṇa ||
english: Strengthened by thee, protected by thee, may we attain prizes by thy guidance. Pacify both praises, O thou of true nature — do this henceforth, O shameless one.

sanskrit: a̱yā te̍ agne sa̱midhā̍ vidhema̱ prati̱ stoma̍ṁ śa̱syamā̍naṁ gṛbhāya | dahā̱śaso̍ ra̱kṣasa̍ḥ pā̱hy a1̱̍smān dru̱ho ni̱do mi̍tramaho ava̱dyāt ||
english: With this fuel, O Agni, we would worship thee — take hold of the praise being recited. Burn the sorcerers; protect us from the demons; O great Mitra, from the blame of the treacherous slanderer.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱rāya̍ mī̱ḻhuṣe̍ sa̱joṣā̍ḥ ka̱thā dā̍śemā̱gnaye̍ bṛ̱had bhāḥ | anū̍nena bṛha̱tā va̱kṣathe̱nopa̍ stabhāyad upa̱min na rodha̍ḥ ||
english: Together and in accord, how shall we make offering to Vaiśvānara, the bounteous, to Agni of great light? He has supported the bank like a prop with his undiminished, great vehicle.

sanskrit: mā ni̍ndata̱ ya i̱mām mahya̍ṁ rā̱tiṁ de̱vo da̱dau martyā̍ya sva̱dhāvā̍n | pākā̍ya̱ gṛtso̍ a̱mṛto̱ vice̍tā vaiśvāna̱ro nṛta̍mo ya̱hvo a̱gniḥ ||
english: Do not despise him who gave this gift to me, the mortal — the self-empowered god. Unto the simple one, the clever, immortal, all-knowing Vaiśvānara, most manly, young Agni, made it known.

sanskrit: sāma̍ dvi̱barhā̱ mahi̍ ti̱gmabhṛ̍ṣṭiḥ sa̱hasra̍retā vṛṣa̱bhas tuvi̍ṣmān | pa̱daṁ na gor apa̍gūḻhaṁ vivi̱dvān a̱gnir mahya̱m pred u̍ vocan manī̱ṣām ||
english: Having the great, doubly strong Sāman-chant, sharp-edged, thousand-seeded, a mighty bull — knowing the hidden footprint of the cow, Agni spoke the inspiring thought to me.

sanskrit: pra tām̐ a̱gnir ba̍bhasat ti̱gmaja̍mbha̱s tapi̍ṣṭhena śo̱ciṣā̱ yaḥ su̱rādhā̍ḥ | pra ye mi̱nanti̱ varu̍ṇasya̱ dhāma̍ pri̱yā mi̱trasya̱ ceta̍to dhru̱vāṇi̍ ||
english: Agni of sharp fangs, of excellent gifts, shall devour them with his hottest flame — those who infringe upon the domain of Varuṇa and the cherished, firm, perceiving laws of Mitra.

sanskrit: a̱bhrā̱taro̱ na yoṣa̍ṇo̱ vyanta̍ḥ pati̱ripo̱ na jana̍yo du̱revā̍ḥ | pā̱pāsa̱ḥ santo̍ anṛ̱tā a̍sa̱tyā i̱dam pa̱dam a̍janatā gabhī̱ram ||
english: Like brotherless women straying, like women hostile to their husbands and of ill ways — being wicked, untruthful, and false, they have found this deep place.

sanskrit: i̱dam me̍ agne̱ kiya̍te pāva̱kāmi̍nate gu̱rum bhā̱raṁ na manma̍ | bṛ̱had da̍dhātha dhṛṣa̱tā ga̍bhī̱raṁ ya̱hvam pṛ̱ṣṭham praya̍sā sa̱ptadhā̍tu ||
english: O Agni, this thought of mine for the purifier, the lover — do not put it as a heavy burden. Thou hast boldly placed the great, deep, young back — nourish it with refreshment seven-fold.

sanskrit: tam in nv e̱3̱̍va sa̍ma̱nā sa̍mā̱nam a̱bhi kratvā̍ puna̱tī dhī̱tir a̍śyāḥ ||
english: May that same purifying thought, through the same will, attain to him from the same level.

sanskrit: pra̱vācya̱ṁ vaca̍sa̱ḥ kim me̍ a̱sya guhā̍ hi̱tam upa̍ ni̱ṇig va̍danti | yad u̱sriyā̍ṇā̱m apa̱ vār i̍va̱ vran pāti̍ pri̱yaṁ ru̱po agra̍m pa̱daṁ veḥ ||
english: What is to be uttered of this my speech? They speak of the hidden, the secret laid within. As they cover the outlet of the cows, the bird protects the dear, foremost station of its form.

sanskrit: i̱dam u̱ tyan mahi̍ ma̱hām anī̍ka̱ṁ yad u̱sriyā̱ saca̍ta pū̱rvyaṁ gauḥ | ṛ̱tasya̍ pa̱de adhi̱ dīdyā̍na̱ṁ guhā̍ raghu̱ṣyad ra̍ghu̱yad vi̍veda ||
english: This verily is the great, mighty face — that the primal cow accompanies the dawn-cows. Blazing over the station of Ṛta, the swiftly moving one perceived the swiftly flying one hidden.

sanskrit: adha̍ dyutā̱naḥ pi̱troḥ sacā̱sāma̍nuta̱ guhya̱ṁ cāru̱ pṛśne̍ḥ | mā̱tuṣ pa̱de pa̍ra̱me anti̱ ṣad gor vṛṣṇa̍ḥ śo̱ciṣa̱ḥ praya̍tasya ji̱hvā ||
english: Then the shining one sat beside his parents, following the beautiful secret of speckled Pṛśni. Near the supreme station of the mother-cow sat the tongue of the bull, of the blazing and exalted one.

sanskrit: ṛ̱taṁ vo̍ce̱ nama̍sā pṛ̱cchyamā̍na̱s tavā̱śasā̍ jātavedo̱ yadī̱dam | tvam a̱sya kṣa̍yasi̱ yad dha̱ viśva̍ṁ di̱vi yad u̱ dravi̍ṇa̱ṁ yat pṛ̍thi̱vyām ||
english: Being questioned with reverence I speak the truth, O Jātavedas, by thy command if this be so: thou rulest over all that exists, that which is in heaven and that which is wealth upon earth.

sanskrit: kiṁ no̍ a̱sya dravi̍ṇa̱ṁ kad dha̱ ratna̱ṁ vi no̍ voco jātavedaś ciki̱tvān | guhādhva̍naḥ para̱maṁ yan no̍ a̱sya reku̍ pa̱daṁ na ni̍dā̱nā aga̍nma ||
english: What is our wealth in this, what indeed is the treasure? Declare it to us, O all-knowing Jātavedas. The highest point of the hidden path — of that empty station we did not come to the source.

sanskrit: kā ma̱ryādā̍ va̱yunā̱ kad dha̍ vā̱mam acchā̍ gamema ra̱ghavo̱ na vāja̍m | ka̱dā no̍ de̱vīr a̱mṛta̍sya̱ patnī̱ḥ sūro̱ varṇe̍na tatanann u̱ṣāsa̍ḥ ||
english: What is the boundary, what the guiding marks? How shall we swift ones reach that which is beautiful, as if a prize? When shall the divine wives of the immortal, the Dawns, be stretched out with the color of the Sun?

sanskrit: a̱ni̱reṇa̱ vaca̍sā pha̱lgve̍na pra̱tītye̍na kṛ̱dhunā̍tṛ̱pāsa̍ḥ | adhā̱ te a̍gne̱ kim i̱hā va̍danty anāyu̱dhāsa̱ āsa̍tā sacantām ||
english: With dustless, trifling, obvious, trembling, unsatisfied speech — what do they say here to thee, O Agni? Let the unarmed ones sit and follow their own ways.

sanskrit: a̱sya śri̱ye sa̍midhā̱nasya̱ vṛṣṇo̱ vaso̱r anī̍ka̱ṁ dama̱ ā ru̍roca | ruśa̱d vasā̍naḥ su̱dṛśī̍karūpaḥ kṣi̱tir na rā̱yā pu̍ru̱vāro̍ adyaut ||
english: For the beauty of this enkindled bull, the face of good Vasu shone in the house. Clothed in brightness, of beautiful form to behold — like a dwelling with wealth he gleamed, of many gifts.

sanskrit: ū̱rdhva ū̱ ṣu ṇo̍ adhvarasya hota̱r agne̱ tiṣṭha̍ de̱vatā̍tā̱ yajī̍yān | tvaṁ hi viśva̍m a̱bhy asi̱ manma̱ pra ve̱dhasa̍ś cit tirasi manī̱ṣām ||
english: Stand erect, O Hotṛ Agni, at our sacrifice, more worthy of worship in the divine assembly. For thou dost surpass all thought, and thou dost even overcome the wisdom of the wise ordainer.

sanskrit: amū̍ro̱ hotā̱ ny a̍sādi vi̱kṣv a1̱̍gnir ma̱ndro vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ prace̍tāḥ | ū̱rdhvam bhā̱nuṁ sa̍vi̱tevā̍śre̱n mete̍va dhū̱maṁ sta̍bhāya̱d upa̱ dyām ||
english: The blameless Hotṛ Agni, the joyous, all-knowing one has taken his seat among the tribes. He has raised his light on high like Savitṛ; like a post he has propped the smoke up to heaven.

sanskrit: ya̱tā su̍jū̱rṇī rā̱tinī̍ ghṛ̱tācī̍ pradakṣi̱ṇid de̱vatā̍tim urā̱ṇaḥ | ud u̱ svaru̍r nava̱jā nākraḥ pa̱śvo a̍nakti̱ sudhi̍taḥ su̱meka̍ḥ ||
english: Wearing the good burnished one, the gift-giving, ghee-dripping one, the divine gathering moving to the right — the well-aimed, well-fitted one anoints the new-born, rafter-like sacrifice-post.

sanskrit: stī̱rṇe ba̱rhiṣi̍ samidhā̱ne a̱gnā ū̱rdhvo a̍dhva̱ryur ju̍juṣā̱ṇo a̍sthāt | pary a̱gniḥ pa̍śu̱pā na hotā̍ trivi̱ṣṭy e̍ti pra̱diva̍ urā̱ṇaḥ ||
english: When the sacred grass is strewn and Agni is kindled, the Adhvaryu stands erect, delighting. Agni the Hotṛ, like a herdsman, goes around thrice, moving, wearing them from of old.

sanskrit: pari̱ tmanā̍ mi̱tadru̍r eti̱ hotā̱gnir ma̱ndro madhu̍vacā ṛ̱tāvā̍ | drava̍nty asya vā̱jino̱ na śokā̱ bhaya̍nte̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nā̱ yad abhrā̍ṭ ||
english: The Hotṛ Agni, measured in gait, goes around of himself, joyous, speaking sweetly, truth-bearing. His flames run like prize horses; all beings tremble when he blazes forth.

sanskrit: bha̱drā te̍ agne svanīka sa̱ṁdṛg gho̱rasya̍ sa̱to viṣu̍ṇasya̱ cāru̍ḥ | na yat te̍ śo̱cis tama̍sā̱ vara̍nta̱ na dhva̱smāna̍s ta̱nvī̱3̱̍ repa̍ ā dhu̱ḥ ||
english: Auspicious is thy appearance, O Agni of beautiful face, though thy nature is terrible and varied. Neither does the darkness veil thy blazing light, nor do the scattered sparks put any taint upon thy body.

sanskrit: na yasya̱ sātu̱r jani̍to̱r avā̍ri̱ na mā̱tarā̍pi̱tarā̱ nū ci̍d i̱ṣṭau | adhā̍ mi̱tro na sudhi̍taḥ pāva̱ko̱3̱̍ 'gnir dī̍dāya̱ mānu̍ṣīṣu vi̱kṣu ||
english: None has checked his conquest; neither father nor mother could hold him when he is desired. Then, like Mitra, well-settled and purifying, Agni shone among the human tribes.

sanskrit: dvir yam pañca̱ jīja̍nan sa̱ṁvasā̍nā̱ḥ svasā̍ro a̱gnim mānu̍ṣīṣu vi̱kṣu | u̱ṣa̱rbudha̍m atha̱ryo̱3̱̍ na danta̍ṁ śu̱kraṁ svāsa̍m para̱śuṁ na ti̱gmam ||
english: Twice-five sisters dwelling together gave birth to Agni among the human tribes — him who wakens at dawn, sharp-toothed like Atharvan's tooth, bright, well-breathing, keen like an axe.

sanskrit: tava̱ tye a̍gne ha̱rito̍ ghṛta̱snā rohi̍tāsa ṛ̱jvañca̱ḥ svañca̍ḥ | a̱ru̱ṣāso̱ vṛṣa̍ṇa ṛjumu̱ṣkā ā de̱vatā̍tim ahvanta da̱smāḥ ||
english: Thy golden-dripping, reddish steeds, O Agni, straight-going and well-going — the ruddy, bull-like, straight-membered, wondrous ones — they called to the divine gathering.

sanskrit: ye ha̱ tye te̱ saha̍mānā a̱yāsa̍s tve̱ṣāso̍ agne a̱rcaya̱ś cara̍nti | śye̱nāso̱ na du̍vasa̱nāso̱ artha̍ṁ tuviṣva̱ṇaso̱ māru̍ta̱ṁ na śardha̍ḥ ||
english: Those resistless, tireless, fierce, shining, roaming flames of thine, O Agni, march toward their goal — like hawks in service, with great noise, like the Marut-troop.

sanskrit: akā̍ri̱ brahma̍ samidhāna̱ tubhya̱ṁ śaṁsā̍ty u̱kthaṁ yaja̍te̱ vy ū̍ dhāḥ | hotā̍ram a̱gnim manu̍ṣo̱ ni ṣe̍dur nama̱syanta̍ u̱śija̱ḥ śaṁsa̍m ā̱yoḥ ||
english: The prayer has been fashioned for thee, O enkindled one; he recites the hymn and worships, he has distributed. The Uśijas, the desiring ones, reverently placed Agni the Hotṛ of men, proclaiming the praise of life.

sanskrit: a̱yam i̱ha pra̍tha̱mo dhā̍yi dhā̱tṛbhi̱r hotā̱ yaji̍ṣṭho adhva̱reṣv īḍya̍ḥ | yam apna̍vāno̱ bhṛga̍vo viruru̱cur vane̍ṣu ci̱traṁ vi̱bhva̍ṁ vi̱śe-vi̍śe ||
english: He was here established first by the establishers, the Hotṛ most worthy of worship at sacrifices, to be praised — him whom the Bhṛgus of Apnavāna made resound in the forests, the many-formed, the mighty one, in every tribe.

sanskrit: agne̍ ka̱dā ta̍ ānu̱ṣag bhuva̍d de̱vasya̱ ceta̍nam | adhā̱ hi tvā̍ jagṛbhri̱re martā̍so vi̱kṣv īḍya̍m ||
english: O Agni, when shall thy divine perception come hereafter in succession? Then mortals have seized upon thee, the praiseworthy one, among the tribes.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tāvā̍na̱ṁ vice̍tasa̱m paśya̍nto̱ dyām i̍va̱ stṛbhi̍ḥ | viśve̍ṣām adhva̱rāṇā̍ṁ haska̱rtāra̱ṁ dame̍-dame ||
english: Looking upon the truth-bearing, all-knowing one as at the star-studded sky — the one who will complete all sacrifices, in every house.

sanskrit: ā̱śuṁ dū̱taṁ vi̱vasva̍to̱ viśvā̱ yaś ca̍rṣa̱ṇīr a̱bhi | ā ja̍bhruḥ ke̱tum ā̱yavo̱ bhṛga̍vāṇaṁ vi̱śe-vi̍śe ||
english: The swift messenger of Vivasvat who surpasses all peoples — the descendants of Āyu, the Bhṛgavāṇas, seized the beacon, in every tribe.

sanskrit: tam ī̱ṁ hotā̍ram ānu̱ṣak ci̍ki̱tvāṁsa̱ṁ ni ṣe̍dire | ra̱ṇvam pā̍va̱kaśo̍ciṣa̱ṁ yaji̍ṣṭhaṁ sa̱pta dhāma̍bhiḥ ||
english: Him, the perceiving Hotṛ, they have seated in unbroken succession — the joyous, purely-blazing, most worthy of worship one, with his seven stations.

sanskrit: taṁ śaśva̍tīṣu mā̱tṛṣu̱ vana̱ ā vī̱tam aśri̍tam | ci̱traṁ santa̱ṁ guhā̍ hi̱taṁ su̱veda̍ṁ kūcida̱rthina̍m ||
english: Him, wrapped in eternal mothers, set in the wood, not touching the ground — the many-formed one, hidden in the secret place, well-known, and sought from somewhere.

sanskrit: sa̱sasya̱ yad viyu̍tā̱ sasmi̱nn ūdha̍nn ṛ̱tasya̱ dhāma̍n ra̱ṇaya̍nta de̱vāḥ | ma̱hām̐ a̱gnir nama̍sā rā̱taha̍vyo̱ ver a̍dhva̱rāya̱ sada̱m id ṛ̱tāvā̍ ||
english: When the gods made sport in the same udder of the two companions, at the station of Ṛta — great Agni, the truth-bearer, invited with oblations by reverence, is ever the bird of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: ver a̍dhva̱rasya̍ dū̱tyā̍ni vi̱dvān u̱bhe a̱ntā roda̍sī saṁciki̱tvān | dū̱ta ī̍yase pra̱diva̍ urā̱ṇo vi̱duṣṭa̍ro di̱va ā̱rodha̍nāni ||
english: Knowing the missions of the bird of the sacrifice, perceiving both extremities of the two worlds together — thou goest as messenger from of old, wearing them — more knowing are the ascents of heaven.

sanskrit: kṛ̱ṣṇaṁ ta̱ ema̱ ruśa̍taḥ pu̱ro bhāś ca̍ri̱ṣṇv a1̱̍rcir vapu̍ṣā̱m id eka̍m | yad apra̍vītā̱ dadha̍te ha̱ garbha̍ṁ sa̱dyaś ci̍j jā̱to bhava̱sīd u̍ dū̱taḥ ||
english: Thy black trail and the bright light in front — the moving flame, indeed the one form of forms; when the inciting ones establish the embryo, thou art straightway born and immediately art the messenger.

sanskrit: sa̱dyo jā̱tasya̱ dadṛ̍śāna̱m ojo̱ yad a̍sya̱ vāto̍ anu̱vāti̍ śo̱ciḥ | vṛ̱ṇakti̍ ti̱gmām a̍ta̱seṣu̍ ji̱hvāṁ sthi̱rā ci̱d annā̍ dayate̱ vi jambhai̍ḥ ||
english: The strength of him newly born became visible when the wind blows following his flame. He sharpens his sharp tongue in the dry lands; he splits even firm foods with his jaws.

sanskrit: tṛ̱ṣu yad annā̍ tṛ̱ṣuṇā̍ va̱vakṣa̍ tṛ̱ṣuṁ dū̱taṁ kṛ̍ṇute ya̱hvo a̱gniḥ ||
english: Since he grew on dry foods with the dry — young Agni makes a swift messenger of the swift.

sanskrit: dū̱taṁ vo̍ vi̱śvave̍dasaṁ havya̱vāha̱m ama̍rtyam | yaji̍ṣṭham ṛñjase gi̱rā ||
english: With song I adorn the messenger, the all-knowing conveyor of oblations, the immortal, the most worthy of worship.

sanskrit: sa hi vedā̱ vasu̍dhitim ma̱hām̐ ā̱rodha̍naṁ di̱vaḥ | sa de̱vām̐ eha va̍kṣati ||
english: For he knows the treasure-trove of wealth, the great ascent to heaven; he will convey the gods hither.

sanskrit: sa ve̍da de̱va ā̱nama̍ṁ de̱vām̐ ṛ̍tāya̱te dame̍ | dāti̍ pri̱yāṇi̍ ci̱d vasu̍ ||
english: He, the divine one, knows the bowing of the gods, for the truth-seeker in his house; he gives even beloved goods.

sanskrit: sa hotā̱ sed u̍ dū̱tya̍ṁ ciki̱tvām̐ a̱ntar ī̍yate | vi̱dvām̐ ā̱rodha̍naṁ di̱vaḥ ||
english: He is the Hotṛ and he perceiving the duty of the messenger, goes between, knowing the ascent to heaven.

sanskrit: te syā̍ma̱ ye a̱gnaye̍ dadā̱śur ha̱vyadā̍tibhiḥ | ya ī̱m puṣya̍nta indha̱te ||
english: May we be among those who have presented to Agni with gift-giving oblations — those who kindle him and make him thrive.

sanskrit: te rā̱yā te su̱vīryai̍ḥ sasa̱vāṁso̱ vi śṛ̍ṇvire | ye a̱gnā da̍dhi̱re duva̍ḥ ||
english: They, having won both wealth and heroic strength, became renowned — those who placed their service in Agni.

sanskrit: a̱sme rāyo̍ di̱ve-di̍ve̱ saṁ ca̍rantu puru̱spṛha̍ḥ | a̱sme vājā̍sa īratām ||
english: May riches much-desired come to us day by day; may prizes be roused to us.

sanskrit: sa vipra̍ś carṣaṇī̱nāṁ śava̍sā̱ mānu̍ṣāṇām | ati̍ kṣi̱preva̍ vidhyati ||
english: He, the inspired one of the peoples, with the might of men, pierces through like an arrow.

sanskrit: agne̍ mṛ̱ḻa ma̱hām̐ a̍si̱ ya ī̱m ā de̍va̱yuṁ jana̍m | i̱yetha̍ ba̱rhir ā̱sada̍m ||
english: O Agni, be gracious — thou art mighty, thou who comest to the god-seeking person who approaches the sacred grass to sit upon it.

sanskrit: sa mānu̍ṣīṣu dū̱ḻabho̍ vi̱kṣu prā̱vīr ama̍rtyaḥ | dū̱to viśve̍ṣām bhuvat ||
english: Hard to overcome among human tribes, the immortal protector — may he become the messenger of all.

sanskrit: sa sadma̱ pari̍ ṇīyate̱ hotā̍ ma̱ndro divi̍ṣṭiṣu | u̱ta potā̱ ni ṣī̍dati ||
english: He is led around the dwelling, the joyous Hotṛ, at the celestial ceremonies; and he sits down as the Potṛ.

sanskrit: u̱ta gnā a̱gnir a̍dhva̱ra u̱to gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱r dame̍ | u̱ta bra̱hmā ni ṣī̍dati ||
english: And Agni is the divine lady's companion at the sacrifice, and the lord of the house in the home; and he sits down as the Brahman-priest.

sanskrit: veṣi̱ hy a̍dhvarīya̱tām u̍pava̱ktā janā̍nām | ha̱vyā ca̱ mānu̍ṣāṇām ||
english: For thou art the speaker on behalf of those performing the sacrifice, and of the people; and of the oblations of humans.

sanskrit: veṣīd v a̍sya dū̱tya1̱̍ṁ yasya̱ jujo̍ṣo adhva̱ram | ha̱vyam marta̍sya̱ voḻha̍ve ||
english: He fulfills the duty of messenger for him whose sacrifice thou hast enjoyed — to carry the mortal's oblation.

sanskrit: a̱smāka̍ṁ joṣy adhva̱ram a̱smāka̍ṁ ya̱jñam a̍ṅgiraḥ | a̱smāka̍ṁ śṛṇudhī̱ hava̍m ||
english: Enjoy our sacrifice, our worship, O Aṅgiras; hear our call.

sanskrit: pari̍ te dū̱ḻabho̱ ratho̱ 'smām̐ a̍śnotu vi̱śvata̍ḥ | yena̱ rakṣa̍si dā̱śuṣa̍ḥ ||
english: May thy hard-to-conquer chariot encompass us on all sides — that with which thou protectest the worshiper.

sanskrit: agne̱ tam a̱dyāśva̱ṁ na stomai̱ḥ kratu̱ṁ na bha̱draṁ hṛ̍di̱spṛśa̍m | ṛ̱dhyāmā̍ ta̱ ohai̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, today let us attain through songs that will-power touching the heart, auspicious as a horse — may we thrive through thy invocations.

sanskrit: adhā̱ hy a̍gne̱ krato̍r bha̱drasya̱ dakṣa̍sya sā̱dhoḥ | ra̱thīr ṛ̱tasya̍ bṛha̱to ba̱bhūtha̍ ||
english: For, O Agni, thou hast become the charioteer of the auspicious will-power, of the good discernment, of the great truth.

sanskrit: e̱bhir no̍ a̱rkair bhavā̍ no a̱rvāṅ sva1̱̍r ṇa jyoti̍ḥ | agne̱ viśve̍bhiḥ su̱manā̱ anī̍kaiḥ ||
english: With these songs be turned toward us, O Agni — like the sun-light, with all thy faces, well-disposed.

sanskrit: ā̱bhiṣ ṭe̍ a̱dya gī̱rbhir gṛ̱ṇanto 'gne̱ dāśe̍ma | pra te̍ di̱vo na sta̍nayanti̱ śuṣmā̍ḥ ||
english: Praising thee today with these songs, O Agni, may we make offerings. Thy vigors thunder forth like those of heaven.

sanskrit: tava̱ svādi̱ṣṭhāgne̱ saṁdṛ̍ṣṭir i̱dā ci̱d ahna̍ i̱dā ci̍d a̱ktoḥ | śri̱ye ru̱kmo na ro̍cata upā̱ke ||
english: Thy most pleasant sight, O Agni, whether now by day or now by night, shines near like a golden ornament of beauty.

sanskrit: ghṛ̱taṁ na pū̱taṁ ta̱nūr a̍re̱pāḥ śuci̱ hira̍ṇyam | tat te̍ ru̱kmo na ro̍cata svadhāvaḥ ||
english: Thy body is like purified ghee, spotless, pure gold — that of thine shines like a golden ornament, O self-empowered one.

sanskrit: kṛ̱taṁ ci̱d dhi ṣmā̱ sane̍mi̱ dveṣo 'gna̍ i̱noṣi̱ martā̍t | i̱tthā yaja̍mānād ṛtāvaḥ ||
english: Even an established hatred thou drivest away from the mortal, O Agni — from the worshiper here in this way, O truth-bearer.

sanskrit: śi̱vā na̍ḥ sa̱khyā santu̍ bhrā̱trāgne̍ de̱veṣu̍ yu̱ṣme | sā no̱ nābhi̱ḥ sada̍ne̱ sasmi̱nn ūdha̍n ||
english: May friendships with thee as a brother be auspicious to us, O Agni, among the gods. May that be our navel, in the seat, in the same udder.

sanskrit: bha̱draṁ te̍ agne sahasi̱nn anī̍kam upā̱ka ā ro̍cate̱ sūrya̍sya | ruśa̍d dṛ̱śe da̍dṛśe nakta̱yā ci̱d arū̍kṣitaṁ dṛ̱śa ā rū̱pe anna̍m ||
english: O Agni, O son of power, thy face shines auspiciously near, like that of the sun. Bright to see, it is seen even at night — undaunted, beautiful in form, the food of sight.

sanskrit: vi ṣā̍hy agne gṛṇa̱te ma̍nī̱ṣāṁ khaṁ vepa̍sā tuvijāta̱ stavā̍naḥ | viśve̍bhi̱r yad vā̱vana̍ḥ śukra de̱vais tan no̍ rāsva sumaho̱ bhūri̱ manma̍ ||
english: Blow up for the singer his thought, O Agni, piercing the void with trembling, as thou art praised, O thou born mightily. What thou hast won together with all the gods, O bright one — grant us that, O greatly great one, and abundant thought.

sanskrit: tvad a̍gne̱ kāvyā̱ tvan ma̍nī̱ṣās tvad u̱kthā jā̍yante̱ rādhyā̍ni | tvad e̍ti̱ dravi̍ṇaṁ vī̱rape̍śā i̱tthādhi̍ye dā̱śuṣe̱ martyā̍ya ||
english: From thee, O Agni, poems arise, from thee inspired thoughts, from thee come hymns of achievement. From thee comes wealth of varied beauty — such is the understanding for the worshiping mortal.

sanskrit: tvad vā̱jī vā̍jambha̱ro vihā̍yā abhiṣṭi̱kṛj jā̍yate sa̱tyaśu̍ṣmaḥ ||
english: From thee the prize-horse, the burden-bearing, heaven-flying, victory-making one is born, of true vigor.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne pratha̱maṁ de̍va̱yanto̍ de̱vam martā̍ amṛta ma̱ndraji̍hvam | dve̱ṣo̱yuta̱m ā vi̍vāsanti dhī̱bhir damū̍nasaṁ gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱m amū̍ram ||
english: Thee, O immortal Agni, the mortals desiring the gods worship first among the divine — the god of the joyous tongue, yoked to enmity — with thoughts they serve the householder, the lord of the house, the blameless one.

sanskrit: ā̱re a̱smad ama̍tim ā̱re aṁha̍ ā̱re viśvā̍ṁ durma̱tiṁ yan ni̱pāsi̍ | do̱ṣā śi̱vaḥ sa̍hasaḥ sūno agne̱ yaṁ de̱va ā ci̱t saca̍se sva̱sti ||
english: Far from us keep ignorance, far from us distress, far from us every ill thought — so thou dost guard. Auspicious at night, O son of power, O Agni — whom even a god accompanies with welfare.

sanskrit: yas tvām a̍gna i̱nadha̍te ya̱tasru̱k tris te̱ anna̍ṁ kṛ̱ṇava̱t sasmi̱nn aha̍n | sa su dyu̱mnair a̱bhy a̍stu pra̱sakṣa̱t tava̱ kratvā̍ jātavedaś ciki̱tvān ||
english: He who kindles thee, O Agni, with ladle extended, who prepares thy food thrice on the same day — may he be distinguished with glories, eminent, through thy power, O all-knowing Jātavedas.

sanskrit: i̱dhmaṁ yas te̍ ja̱bhara̍c chaśramā̱ṇo ma̱ho a̍gne̱ anī̍ka̱m ā sa̍pa̱ryan | sa i̍dhā̱naḥ prati̍ do̱ṣām u̱ṣāsa̱m puṣya̍n ra̱yiṁ sa̍cate̱ ghnann a̱mitrā̍n ||
english: He who brings thee fuel toiling, O great Agni, tending thy mighty face — enkindling thee, meeting evening and dawn, thriving with wealth, he is accompanied as he slays the enemies.

sanskrit: a̱gnir ī̍śe bṛha̱taḥ kṣa̱triya̍syā̱gnir vāja̍sya para̱masya̍ rā̱yaḥ | dadhā̍ti̱ ratna̍ṁ vidha̱te yavi̍ṣṭho̱ vy ā̍nu̱ṣaṅ martyā̍ya sva̱dhāvā̍n ||
english: Agni rules over great sovereignty, Agni over the highest prize and wealth. The most youthful, self-empowered one bestows treasure upon the worshiper — for the mortal repeatedly.

sanskrit: yac ci̱d dhi te̍ puruṣa̱trā ya̍vi̱ṣṭhāci̍ttibhiś cakṛ̱mā kac ci̱d āga̍ḥ | kṛ̱dhī ṣv a1̱̍smām̐ adi̍te̱r anā̍gā̱n vy enā̍ṁsi śiśratho̱ viṣva̍g agne ||
english: Whatever sin we have committed against thee in many places through thoughtlessness, O most youthful — make us free of sin like Aditi; scatter our transgressions in all directions, O Agni.

sanskrit: ma̱haś ci̍d agna̱ ena̍so a̱bhīka̍ ū̱rvād de̱vānā̍m u̱ta martyā̍nām | mā te̱ sakhā̍ya̱ḥ sada̱m id ri̍ṣāma̱ yacchā̍ to̱kāya̱ tana̍yāya̱ śaṁ yoḥ ||
english: Even from great sin, O Agni, confront it — from the wide expanse of both gods and mortals. May thy friends never always be harmed; grant welfare to our offspring and progeny.

sanskrit: yathā̍ ha̱ tyad va̍savo gau̱rya̍ṁ cit pa̱di ṣi̱tām amu̍ñcatā yajatrāḥ | e̱vo ṣv a1̱̍sman mu̍ñcatā̱ vy aṁha̱ḥ pra tā̍ry agne prata̱raṁ na̱ āyu̍ḥ ||
english: As the worshipful Vasus freed even the wild cow bound by its leg — even so free us from distress, O Agni; extend our life further and further.

sanskrit: praty a̱gnir u̱ṣasā̱m agra̍m akhyad vibhātī̱nāṁ su̱manā̍ ratna̱dheya̍m | yā̱tam a̍śvinā su̱kṛto̍ duro̱ṇam ut sūryo̱ jyoti̍ṣā de̱va e̍ti ||
english: Agni beheld the vanguard of the shining Dawns, benevolent, giving treasure. Come, O Aśvins, to the dwelling of the good-doers; the divine Sun rises with his light.

sanskrit: ū̱rdhvam bhā̱nuṁ sa̍vi̱tā de̱vo a̍śred dra̱psaṁ davi̍dhvad gavi̱ṣo na satvā̍ | anu̍ vra̱taṁ varu̍ṇo yanti mi̱tro yat sūrya̍ṁ di̱vy ā̍ro̱haya̍nti ||
english: The divine Savitṛ has raised his light on high, tossing the drop like a hero seeking cattle. Varuṇa and Mitra follow his law when they cause the Sun to rise in the heavens.

sanskrit: yaṁ sī̱m akṛ̍ṇva̱n tama̍se vi̱pṛce̍ dhru̱vakṣe̍mā̱ ana̍vasyanto̱ artha̍m | taṁ sūrya̍ṁ ha̱rita̍ḥ sa̱pta ya̱hvīḥ spaśa̱ṁ viśva̍sya̱ jaga̍to vahanti ||
english: Him whom they made to separate from darkness — the firm abode, not wearying, for their goal — that Sun, the seven young tawny mares carry, the spy of the whole world.

sanskrit: vahi̍ṣṭhebhir vi̱hara̍n yāsi̱ tantu̍m ava̱vyaya̱nn asi̍taṁ deva̱ vasma̍ ||
english: Spreading with the best conveyors thou goest thy path, unwinding the dark garment, O divine one.

sanskrit: anā̍yato̱ ani̍baddhaḥ ka̱thāyaṁ nya̍ṅṅ uttā̱no 'va̍ padyate̱ na | kayā̍ yāti sva̱dhayā̱ ko da̍darśa di̱vaḥ ska̱mbhaḥ samṛ̍taḥ pāti̱ nāka̍m ||
english: Unattached, unbound — how does this one not fall down, though face downward and face upward? By what self-power does he travel? Who has seen? The pillar of heaven, well-fitted, protects the vault of the sky.

sanskrit: praty a̱gnir u̱ṣaso̍ jā̱tave̍dā̱ akhya̍d de̱vo roca̍mānā̱ maho̍bhiḥ | ā nā̍satyorugā̱yā rathe̍ne̱maṁ ya̱jñam upa̍ no yāta̱m accha̍ ||
english: Agni, the all-knowing, the divine one, beheld the Dawns shining with their great lights. Come to this sacrifice of ours on the wide-praised chariot, O Nāsatyas — come hither.

sanskrit: ū̱rdhvaṁ ke̱tuṁ sa̍vi̱tā de̱vo a̍śre̱j jyoti̱r viśva̍smai̱ bhuva̍nāya kṛ̱ṇvan | āprā̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī a̱ntari̍kṣa̱ṁ vi sūryo̍ ra̱śmibhi̱ś ceki̍tānaḥ ||
english: The divine Savitṛ has raised his banner on high, making light for every world. Filling heaven and earth and the atmosphere, the Sun shines forth conspicuously with his rays.

sanskrit: ā̱vaha̍nty aru̱ṇīr jyoti̱ṣāgā̍n ma̱hī ci̱trā ra̱śmibhi̱ś ceki̍tānā | pra̱bo̱dhaya̍ntī suvi̱tāya̍ de̱vy u1̱̍ṣā ī̍yate su̱yujā̱ rathe̍na ||
english: The reddish cows have come bringing light; great and brilliant, shining conspicuously with their rays, the divine Dawn awakening for good fortune, goes forth on a well-yoked chariot.

sanskrit: ā vā̱ṁ vahi̍ṣṭhā i̱ha te va̍hantu̱ rathā̱ aśvā̍sa u̱ṣaso̱ vyu̍ṣṭau | i̱me hi vā̍m madhu̱peyā̍ya̱ somā̍ a̱smin ya̱jñe vṛ̍ṣaṇā mādayethām ||
english: May the best horses and chariots of the Dawns carry you twain hither at the breaking of Dawn. For here, O bulls, are the Soma-draughts for you to drink at this sacrifice — rejoice.

sanskrit: anā̍yato̱ ani̍baddhaḥ ka̱thāyaṁ nya̍ṅṅ uttā̱no 'va̍ padyate̱ na | kayā̍ yāti sva̱dhayā̱ ko da̍darśa di̱vaḥ ska̱mbhaḥ samṛ̍taḥ pāti̱ nāka̍m ||
english: Unattached, unbound — how does this one not fall down, though face downward and face upward? By what self-power does he travel? Who has seen? The pillar of heaven, well-fitted, protects the vault of the sky.

sanskrit: a̱gnir hotā̍ no adhva̱re vā̱jī san pari̍ ṇīyate | de̱vo de̱veṣu̍ ya̱jñiya̍ḥ ||
english: Agni, the Hotṛ, being the prize-winner, is led around at our sacrifice — the god, worthy of worship among the gods.

sanskrit: pari̍ trivi̱ṣṭy a̍dhva̱raṁ yāty a̱gnī ra̱thīr i̍va | ā de̱veṣu̱ prayo̍ dadha̍t ||
english: Agni goes thrice around the sacrifice like a charioteer, placing enjoyment among the gods.

sanskrit: pari̱ vāja̍patiḥ ka̱vir a̱gnir ha̱vyāny a̍kramīt | dadha̱d ratnā̍ni dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: Agni the lord of prizes, the seer, strode around the oblations, bestowing treasures upon the worshiper.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ yaḥ sṛñja̍ye pu̱ro dai̍vavā̱te sa̍mi̱dhyate̍ | dyu̱mām̐ a̍mitra̱dambha̍naḥ ||
english: This one who is kindled in the towns of the Sṛñjayas and Daivavātas — the glorious one, the crusher of enemies.

sanskrit: asya̍ ghā vī̱ra īva̍to̱ 'gner ī̍śīta̱ martya̍ḥ | ti̱gmaja̍mbhasya mī̱ḻhuṣa̍ḥ ||
english: May the mortal have mastery over this advancing Agni's active strength — of the sharp-toothed, bounteous one.

sanskrit: tam arva̍nta̱ṁ na sā̍na̱sim a̍ru̱ṣaṁ na di̱vaḥ śiśu̍m | ma̱rmṛ̱jyante̍ di̱ve-di̍ve ||
english: Him, like a swift horse, like the sharpening stone, like the red child of heaven — they polish him day by day.

sanskrit: bodha̱d yan mā̱ hari̍bhyāṁ kumā̱raḥ sā̍hade̱vyaḥ | acchā̱ na hū̱ta ud a̍ram ||
english: That the youthful Sāhadevya may perceive me from his two bay horses — rising up toward us like one called.

sanskrit: u̱ta tyā ya̍ja̱tā harī̍ kumā̱rāt sā̍hade̱vyāt | praya̍tā sa̱dya ā da̍de ||
english: And those two worshipful bay horses from the youthful Sāhadevya — immediately offered, they were taken at once.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa vā̍ṁ devāv aśvinā kumā̱raḥ sā̍hade̱vyaḥ | dī̱rghāyu̍r astu̱ soma̍kaḥ ||
english: This youthful Sāhadevya Somaka — may he be long-lived for you twain gods, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: taṁ yu̱vaṁ de̍vāv aśvinā kumā̱raṁ sā̍hade̱vyam | dī̱rghāyu̍ṣaṁ kṛṇotana ||
english: Him, the youthful Sāhadevya — do ye two gods, O Aśvins, make long-lived.
